title: UAE Stargate AI campus
summary: A planned Gulf AI data-centre campus backed by sovereign and US partners.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Announced in 2025, the UAE Stargate project is planned as a multi-gigawatt AI campus in Abu Dhabi, linking G42, MGX, OpenAI and Oracle with US government backing for chip exports. It is the largest attempt to make a Gulf state a compute jurisdiction rather than a customer. Power, cooling and chip export licences are the constraints, and the announced capacity is far ahead of built capacity.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Pilot
Estimated window 2025–2028
Confidence label Speculative
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Gulf compute is a bet on cheap energy plus political alignment; the risk is announced capacity that never gets powered.

What Would Change The View

  • Power contracts and grid connection.
  • Chip export licences.
  • Anchor tenant commitments.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
